INDS 501.faculty: Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies
INDS 501.description: Introduction to concepts and practice in higher education instruction; emphasis on lesson planning, student participation and instructional aides; includes video-taped practice teacher/peer feedback 28 classroom hours. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

INDS 502.faculty: Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies
INDS 502.description: Seminars, lectures, and discussions of topics involving several faculties. Contact the Interdisciplinary Studies Program for specific topics (www.isgp.ubc.ca). This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

INDS 530.faculty: Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies
INDS 530.description: A series of directed readings related to student's area of interdisciplinary studies. This advanced course may be taken upon approval of the Program head. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
